claim_text: AC consumes the imported A_M and A_U candidates only through their exact IDs, hashes, family domains and atomic binders, without copying their complete continuation views.
assumptions_used: authorized source commits; imported blobs preserved

member_domain: b_M in B_M(d) and b_U in B_U(d)
claim_text: A pair is compatible if and only if it shares the exact primitive tuple d, each source binder belongs to its complete family at d, source hashes match and neither binder is spliced; no further cross-rule selection or stochastic coupling is authorized.
assumptions_used: counterfactual rules share primitives but not equilibrium-selection or randomization primitives

claim_text: The primary object K_AC(d) is the exact member-level joint relation carrying both type-conditioned payoff vectors, their U-minus-M contrasts and the ordered pair of complete source-bound outcome laws.
selection_status: no marginal payoff-image product and no coordinate recombination
assumptions_used: exact full source members before projections

claim_text: AC has a comparison member if and only if both source fibers are nonempty; a surviving rule remains separately recorded and no none cell receives a payoff sentinel or fictitious comparison.
selection_status: absence is preserved rather than imputed
assumptions_used: literal source none cells; law of the fiber product

claim_text: For every pair, type payoffs are formed before the prior expectation and delta_E equals (1-nu) delta_0 plus nu delta_1.
selection_status: same pair and same two source binders used for every coordinate

claim_text: At nu=0 the exact U payoff vector is (p_0,max{p_0,d_1}); delta_0 and delta_E equal p_0-M_0 while the zero-prior delta_1 remains max{p_0,d_1}-M_1.
selection_status: A_U payoffs fixed; A_M and source-bound outcomes unselected
assumptions_used: prior-support endpoint; zero-prior type remains sequentially rational

claim_text: In the existing low-prior cell U_0=U_1=p_0, so delta_theta=p_0-M_theta and delta_E=p_0-M_E for the same compatible pair.
domain: 0<nu<=nu_star and Delta_U>=0 and d in D_M_plus
selection_status: A_U payoff fixed; complete A_U outcome multiplicity and all A_M binders preserved

claim_text: For nu_star<nu<1, U_0=U_1=u with every u in [u_min,p_1] attained; hence each contrast value is necessarily selection-dependent even fixing b_M, while its sign may remain invariant if the exact sign set is one-sided.
selection_status: all u values and full binders retained

claim_text: At nu=1 the exact U payoff vector is (p_1,p_1), delta_theta=p_1-M_theta and delta_E=delta_1=p_1-M_1.
selection_status: A_U payoffs and on-path outcome fixed; all A_M binders and complete off-path coordinates preserved

claim_text: For each type and ex-ante coordinate, the exact sign set classifies all-pair strict U dominance, strict M dominance, exact ties, weak orderings and selection dependence without choosing an equilibrium.
selection_status: exact sign image of the member-level relation retained
assumptions_used: contrast orientation U-M; nonempty joint fiber

claim_text: No unconditional institutional payoff ranking is added: fixed-U cells can still vary through A_M, and the high-prior cell necessarily varies through u; any sharper sign claim must satisfy the exact all-pair sign test.
selection_status: no equilibrium selected to manufacture a ranking
assumptions_used: A_M is an exact symbolic correspondence without authorized closed-form extrema

claim_text: Outcome comparison is the ordered pair of complete type-conditioned source outcome laws from the same two binders; AC defines no unauthorized cross-world coupling, welfare order or scalar delay ranking.
assumptions_used: no cross-rule stochastic-coupling or outcome-order primitive

claim_text: Comparison sets and interval hulls are derived only after K_AC(d); a hull is never substituted for the exact set and marginal payoff images are never made into the primary Cartesian product.

member_domain: all imported payoff and outcome coordinates
claim_text: A_M and A_U values enter AC already at date A with transport factor one and beta_application_count zero; AC applies no additional beta.
assumptions_used: upstream C-to-A transport already completed once inside each source family

claim_text: The dedicated R checker validates source hashes, JSON and ledger schemas, IDs, cells, binders, no-sentinel structure, no-added-beta records, exact expectation identities and representative endpoint and cutoff cases; it makes no equilibrium-proof claim.
